title: Radical realism faces the threat of epiphenomenalism

statements.text: Non-physical properties can have no effects in a world closed under causation, and the mind sciences show no independent need for exotic physical processes, so radical theories struggle to vindicate the view that experiences affect people in virtue of how they feel. Making phenomenal properties intrinsic to basic physical entities buys their potency at the cost of making all physical causation phenomenal.

sources.quote: The threat of epiphenomenalism hangs over radical theories.
